subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/stream` as a shared core command with durable `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and Telegram/Discord/Slack capability gating after the account-config bug and proof gap are fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds a new cross-channel user command, persistent session state, and channel capability contract, which is a product/API boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept Shared Command After Fixes
options.body: Land the shared `/stream` command once account-scoped config inheritance, current-head rebase, and visible channel proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow The MVP
options.body: Limit the command to one owner channel or a smaller storage shape until the cross-channel capability contract is settled.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep #74077 open or close it as not planned if maintainers do not want a durable session-level stream-mode control.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Command After Fixes
recommendation.body: Land the shared `/stream` command once account-scoped config inheritance, current-head rebase, and visible channel proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail ties this owner to recent session-command/state and preview-streaming helper work near the API boundary.
